extensions.name: Message Renderer
extensions.description: Public hermes-webui message-renderer extension (vendored). Replaces the default message transcript rendering. OFF by default since 2026-08-26 (native-first: the native transcript + welcome feature are the product surface; opt in from this panel). Enable/disable any time from this panel.
